name: SM_Skull_PR
dresses: human skull without the jaw, 0.17 x 0.22 x 0.2 m: cranium, brow ridge, cheek bones, eye sockets and nose as dark hollows, eight upper teeth; earth-stained, lichened

fit.pivot: base centre (resting on the palate), faces -Y; tip it on its side for variety

material_exception: shared tiling scan sets with a vertex-colour weathering layer (MI_Prop_* / MI_Struct_*), not private bakes and not yet rows of ART_STANDARD.md section 2. Edge wear, stains and soot are per-vertex. A unique bake per prop is the next step where the weaknesses say so.
known_weaknesses: NOT photoreal: a lathed cranium pushed into shape with three dark hollows and eight block teeth. Reads as a skull at gameplay distance only; no sutures, no zygomatic arches, no nasal bone.
